subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Subscription Traps
description: A quick win: understand Subscription Traps.

hook.text: A free trial asks for your credit card 'just for verification.' You're charged $90 monthly forever.

buildup.text: Subscription traps bury auto-renewal terms in fine print and make cancellation nearly impossible.

discovery.text: Some companies route cancellation through phone lines that are perpetually busy or disconnected.

twist.text: The FTC has sued major companies for dark patterns that trick users into unwanted subscriptions.

climax.text: Millions of consumers pay for services they forgot they signed up for or can't figure out how to cancel.

quiz.question: What is a subscription trap?
options: A free trial that auto-converts to paid with difficult cancellation
